description: This file defines a singleton class 'TalkAudioPlayer' responsible for playing audio data asynchronously using AVAudioPlayer, with support for stopping, delegate callbacks, and watchdog timers to monitor playback. It also includes a struct 'TalkPlaybackResult' to report playback status.

classes.name: TalkAudioPlayer
classes.description: A singleton class managing audio playback using AVAudioPlayer with async control, concurrency safety, and watchdog timer.

classes.name: Playback
classes.description: An internal class managing individual playback state, continuation, finish status, and watchdog task.

methods.name: play(data: Data) async -> TalkPlaybackResult
methods.description: Plays audio data asynchronously, returning a result indicating success or failure.

methods.name: stop() -> Double?
methods.description: Stops playback if active and returns the current playback time.

methods.name: audioPlayerDidFinishPlaying(_:successfully:)
methods.description: Delegate method called when playback finishes, to update internal state.

methods.name: stopInternal(finished: Bool, interruptedAt: Double?)
methods.description: Internal method to stop playback and update state.

methods.name: finish(playback: Playback, result: TalkPlaybackResult)
methods.description: Finalizes playback, cancels watchdog, resumes continuation.

methods.name: armWatchdog(playback: Playback)
methods.description: Sets up a watchdog task to monitor playback timeout and status.
